name: Tenderly
tagline: EVM simulation, debugging, and node RPC for apps and wallets
description: Tenderly provides simulation, transaction debugging, Node RPC, Virtual Environments, and monitoring tools across supported blockchain networks. Developers use it to dry-run transactions, inspect traces, create stateful forks, query on-chain state, and monitor activity. REST API access uses personal-account or organization access tokens via X-Access-Key; many endpoints also identify account and project slugs.

auth.details: Access Token (API key) via X-Access-Key header; create in Dashboard → Account Settings → Authorization. Project slug and account username required in many path-based REST endpoints.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free indefinitely includes browser-based Explorer, full Debugger, and single-transaction UI simulation. The Free plan has no API access, and Node RPC is paid-only.
pricing.paid_plans: Pro and custom Enterprise plans with higher unit allowances for Node, Simulations, Alerts, and Virtual TestNets.

rate_limits: No universal or plan-specific request-rate schedule is published. Node RPC is metered by per-method Tenderly Unit costs; account capacity and limits are arranged with sales.
use_cases: simulate an EVM transaction before sending it
debug a failed transaction with full call traces
get Node RPC / Web3 Gateway access for an EVM chain
fork a mainnet state into a Virtual TestNet for testing
monitor contracts and set transaction alerts
